title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing BS/MS in Computer Science; proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python.
description: Work on real-world software projects alongside experienced engineers at Microsoft.

title: Generation Google Scholarship (APAC)
eligibility: Students pursuing a computer science degree who demonstrate passion for technology and diversity leadership.
qualification: Currently enrolled in 1st or 2nd year undergraduate program in Computer Science or related technical field.
description: Supports computer science students to excel in technology and become leaders in the field.

title: AI Research Fellow
eligibility: Recent graduates or researchers with strong backgrounds in deep learning, math, or physics.
qualification: Strong coding abilities in Python/PyTorch and mathematical foundations.
description: A 6-month mentorship program aimed at transitioning talented researchers into AI alignment and core capabilities research.

title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in pursuing a career in data science.
salary: Free (Audit mode or via Coursera Financial Aid)
description: Master fundamental data science skills including Python, SQL, data visualization, and machine learning.

title: Software Development Engineer - Entry Level
eligibility: Graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's in CS or related field within the next 12 months.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
description: Design, build, and deploy high-scale distributed systems and customer-facing cloud infrastructure at Amazon.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure credits
qualification: Must form a team of up to 4 students and build an innovative tech project using Microsoft Azure.
description: Global technology competition empowering student developers to build solutions for world challenges using AI and cloud tech.
